deterministic.product_description: Bumper (front) — exterior body/trim module combining fascia, energy-management structure, and integrated sensing, lighting, and electronics.
functions: Impact & energy management (crash and pedestrian protection)
Sensing & driver assistance carrier (radar, LIDAR, camera, PDC, thermal)
Feature integration (towing cover, keyless-entry aerial, EV charge port)

parts.name: Cover part (fascia)
parts.function: Outer painted skin of the bumper module; styling, aerodynamics and carrier for the integrated sensors, lamps, grille, license plate holder and covers; first contact surface in pedestrian and low-speed impacts
parts.evidence_drawing: Large white fascia in the centre of the exploded view, callout 'Cover part', with openings for grille, fog/air intakes and sensor/lighting apertures

parts.name: (Radiator) Grill
parts.function: Front grille admitting cooling air to the radiator; styling element; may carry camera, radar and decorative lighting
parts.evidence_drawing: Dark grille with horizontal slats at left, callout '(Radiator) Grill'; separate lower side grille inserts shown below it

parts.name: Absorber
parts.function: Energy-absorbing foam behind the fascia; manages pedestrian leg impact and low-speed impact energy
parts.evidence_drawing: Elongated foam/beam element at upper right, callout 'Absorber', mounted in front of a crossbeam with crash boxes

parts.name: Lower stiffener (underrun protection)
parts.function: Lower load path below the main beam supporting the pedestrian's lower leg (reduces knee bending) and stiffening the lower fascia
parts.evidence_drawing: Long lower ribbed part below the fascia, callout 'Lower stiffener (underrun protection)'

parts.name: License plate area / holder
parts.function: Provides the space and mounting surface for the front registration plate
parts.regulated_function: space for mounting and fixing of front registration plate
parts.evidence_drawing: Callout 'License plate area/holder' pointing to the grille / lower-centre region where the plate mounts

parts.name: Towing device cover
parts.function: Removable cover closing the access opening to the front towing eye/hook mounting
parts.evidence_drawing: Small cover near the fascia's left side, callout 'Towing device cover'

parts.name: Camera
parts.function: Front-view camera for driver assistance / surround view, mounted in the grille area
parts.material: Housing PP, PA or PA-GF; lens PC or PMMA
parts.evidence_drawing: Small camera unit with connector near top of grille, callout 'Camera'

parts.name: Radar sensor
parts.function: Corner/front radar sensor for driver assistance functions (e.g. collision warning, emergency braking, blind-spot/cross-traffic)
parts.material: Bracket/housing PP, PA or PA-GF; radome PC or PMMA
parts.evidence_drawing: Rectangular sensor with bracket at right side of the fascia, callout 'Radar sensor'

parts.name: Radar / LIDAR sensor (incl. heating)
parts.function: Central long-range radar/LIDAR with heater for de-icing/defogging of the sensor window, supporting ADAS functions
parts.material: Bracket/housing PP, PA or PA-GF; radome/window PC or PMMA
parts.evidence_drawing: Small sensor block with bracket at left of the grille, callout 'Radar/LIDAR sensor incl. heating'

parts.name: PDC sensor
parts.function: Ultrasonic park distance control sensor mounted in the fascia
parts.evidence_drawing: Small cylindrical sensor with bracket above the fascia, callout 'PDC sensor'; further sensor brackets distributed on the fascia

parts.name: Pedestrian impact sensors
parts.function: Sensors (with pressure tube/signal line) on the bumper beam/absorber detecting a pedestrian impact to trigger a deployable pedestrian protection system (e.g. active bonnet)
parts.evidence_drawing: Small sensors with a connecting tube/line above the absorber at upper right, callout 'Pedestrian impact sensors'

parts.name: Temperature / thermal sensor
parts.function: Ambient temperature sensor or thermal (infrared) imaging sensor in the front module
parts.evidence_drawing: Small dark sensor below the central air guide, callout 'Temperature/thermal sensor'

parts.name: Lighting — decorative
parts.function: Illuminated surround/frame of the grille for styling; non-signalling light
parts.evidence_drawing: Light-guide frame at far left surrounding the grille shape, callout 'Lighting (decorative)'

parts.name: (Side) Lighting — signalling
parts.function: Signalling lamp integrated in the side area of the fascia (side marking / side signalling)
parts.evidence_drawing: Highlighted (red-dashed) strip of LED-like segments on the side of the fascia, callout '(Side) Lighting (signalling)'

parts.name: Aerial (keyless entry)
parts.function: Antenna for keyless entry / passive entry system
parts.evidence_drawing: Small grey flat element above the fascia, callout 'Aerial (keyless entry)'

parts.name: "Fuel filler cap" (for EVs)
parts.function: Flap/cover for the EV charging inlet integrated in the bumper fascia
parts.regulated_function: vehicle inlet / coupling system for charging the REESS
parts.evidence_drawing: Dashed rectangle on the fascia front face, callout '„Fuel filler cap“ (for Evs)'

parts.name: Wiring harness
parts.function: Bumper harness connecting sensors, lamps, aerial and heater to the vehicle electrical system
parts.evidence_drawing: Wiring harness with branches and connectors shown at bottom right (no callout)

parts.name: Sensor brackets / air guides / mounting brackets
parts.function: Brackets holding sensors, lamps and fascia to the body; air-guide ducts directing cooling air
parts.evidence_drawing: Numerous black brackets, air ducts and side mounting brackets around the fascia and grille (no callouts)

parts.name: Front crossbeam with crash boxes
parts.function: Main structural bumper beam with deformation elements behind the absorber
parts.evidence_drawing: Long beam with end crash boxes below the absorber at upper right (no separate callout)

parts.name: Fasteners / clips
parts.function: Attachment of fascia, grille and components
parts.evidence_drawing: Small clips and screws scattered in the exploded view

model.light_sources: Not specified in the spec; drawing suggests LED segments / light guides, likely non-replaceable LED light sources — confirm; if replaceable light sources are used, light-source regulations (R37/R99/R128) apply
regulated_functions: space for mounting and fixing of front registration plate
vehicle inlet / coupling system for charging the REESS
search_terms: space for mounting front registration plate
installation of lighting and light-signalling devices
drawing_observations: Exploded view of a complete front bumper module with labelled callouts: Lighting (decorative), Radar/LIDAR sensor incl. heating, Camera, (Radiator) Grill, License plate area/holder, Temperature/thermal sensor, Towing device cover, PDC sensor, „Fuel filler cap“ (for EVs), Aerial (keyless entry), Radar sensor, (Side) Lighting (signalling), Cover part, Lower stiffener (underrun protection), Absorber, Pedestrian impact sensors
Decorative lighting is a light-guide frame surrounding the grille outline
Side signalling lighting is shown as a red-dashed strip of segments on the lateral part of the fascia
EV charging flap is indicated only by a dashed rectangle on the fascia, i.e. optional/variant-dependent
Absorber sits on a crossbeam with crash boxes; pedestrian impact sensors with a connecting line are mounted on/above the absorber
Lower stiffener is a separate long ribbed part below the fascia
Multiple black brackets, air ducts and side grille inserts surround the fascia
A wiring harness with several branches and connectors is shown at bottom right without a callout
Callouts are part identifiers only; no numeric requirements are given in the drawing
